narr: A series of thunderstorms produced heavy rainfall over Galveston County, resulting in flooding in the Bacliff area.
ev: Heavy rain resulted in high water over roadways, making streets impassable. At least 25 structures including many within the Bacliff Villas subdivision were inundated with floodwaters, resulting in water damage.
lsr: PUBLIC REPORTS ON SOCIAL MEDIA OF HIGH WATER AND STREET FLOODING NEAR GALVESTON BAY IN BACLIFF, TEXAS AT THE INTERSECTION OF BAYSHORE DRIVE AND GORDY ROAD.
